about: Haggis schedule inputs. Each tick count and rate carries evidence (MEASURED / CODE-READ / ESTIMATE) and a source. Edit numbers here; no code change is needed. Rates: floor = best case (higher rate). suppliesLadder = supplies computed from the tier tables in haggis.ts. `serves` lists the boards that need the activity; XP to other skills still counts but does not pull the activity earlier. Level and QP requirements also need an activity in `requires`, so the deadline pulls the unlock forward.
